schemaVersion.description: Integer; the player rejects a version it does not know.

app.description: App-level config: landing screen and installed-app identity.

ui.description: Interface text overrides keyed by language code (default: none).

Manifest.description: Everything the player needs at runtime, in one JSON document served at `/data/manifest.json`. Media is referenced by URL, never inlined.

AppConfigFile.description: Shape of `src/data/tour/app.json` — app-level config for the landing screen and the installed-app identity.

analytics.description: Set false to turn off anonymous usage analytics (POST /e). On by default in manifest mode; compiled builds only send anything when the build has a VITE_ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT. Visitors with Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track on are never counted either way. See docs/analytics.md.

embedAllowlist.description: Websites that embed stops of any type, including YouTube and Spotify, may show. When the list has entries, an embed from any other host is not rendered and the player shows a neutral "not available here" notice instead. The usual rules still apply on top: https only, never the player's own origin. An empty or missing list means no limit. See docs/stops.md.

LocalizedString.description: A string localized per language code, e.g. { en: "Choose a tour", de: "Wähle eine Tour" }. The current language is looked up by code; missing codes fall back to defaults.

TourCardConfig.description: Controls which elements render on every tour card in the selection list. The title is always shown. All flags default to true (omitted = shown).

AppDisplayMode.description: Manifest `display`. Standalone is the usual one: no browser UI at all.

AppOrientation.description: Manifest `orientation`. `any` lets the phone rotate the app.

EmbedHost.description: A website an embed may come from: a hostname such as `www.youtube.com`, or `*.example.org` for every subdomain of `example.org` (not `example.org` itself). No scheme, port or path.

extends.description: What to inherit from: a built-in theme or another custom theme of the same manifest (a chain is fine, a cycle is not). Defaults to 'default-light'.

CustomTheme.description: A custom theme as authored in JSON (`src/data/themes/<id>.json`): any subset of  {@link  ThemeConfig } , deep-merged over a built-in theme by the player.

UiText.description: Interface text overrides for one language, merged over the player's built-in locale (or over English for a language with no built-in locale).

id.description: Same as `metadata.id` and every language file's `id`.

languages.description: Language code → that language's tour file.

route.description: The walking route, inlined. Replaces the `mapRoute.geoJSON` relative path that `metadata.json` uses on disk (a manifest has no sibling files).

ManifestTour.description: One tour inside a manifest: shared metadata plus one file per language.

TourMetadataFile.description: Shape of `src/data/tour/<id>/metadata.json` — properties shared across languages.

stopSearchThreshold.description: Show a search field above the stop list when the tour has MORE than this many stops (default: 8). It filters by title and text. Use a large number to never show it.

TourMetadata.description: Tour metadata - shared properties across all language versions These can be overridden in individual language files

MapMarkerColors.description: Per-tour overrides for the map marker background colors. Each field falls back to the theme's `mapMarkers.<state>.backgroundColor`. Number/checkmark colors stay with the theme (white in both shipped themes), so pick backgrounds dark enough for white text — for a deeper restyle give the tour its own `themeId`.

MapRouteConfig.description:
Route polyline configuration. In metadata.json, `geoJSON` is a relative path string ("./route.geojson"). At runtime (after build-time resolution) it becomes a parsed RouteGeoJSON object.

The style fields are optional per-tour overrides of the theme's `mapMarkers.route`. They exist because the basemap is per-tour (`mapProvider` / `mapStyleId`), so a tour on dark tiles can recolor its line without cloning a whole theme. Precedence: mapRoute → theme → built-in default.

coordinates.description: Coordinates in [lng, lat] order — GeoJSON standard.

RouteGeoJSON.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection containing a single LineString (the walking route).

stopSearchThreshold.description: Show a search field above the stop list when the tour has MORE than this many stops (default: 8). It filters by title and text. Use a large number to never show it.

TourFile.description: Shape of a language file, e.g. `src/data/tour/<id>/en.json`. Mirrors  {@link  TourData }  but with runtime-only stop state removed.

anyOf.description: An audio stop as authored in JSON, with runtime playback state removed.

AuthoredStop.description: Any stop as authored in JSON.

subtitles.description: Subtitle files (WebVTT) offered in the video's captions menu. Included in offline downloads.

src.description: Where the WebVTT file (.vtt) is. A file on another origin must be served with CORS headers (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin`), or the browser refuses it.

srclang.description: The language of the subtitles as a BCP 47 code, e.g. `en` or `pt-BR`.

label.description: What the captions menu calls it, e.g. "English".

VideoSubtitle.description: One subtitle file of a video: WebVTT, in one language. The browser's own captions menu offers them.

consentText.description: Consent line shown next to a required checkbox, e.g. "Send me news about new guides". Without it the form has no checkbox.

embedUrl.description: The page to frame. Must be `https://` (the player also refuses a URL on its own origin, where a framed upload could run as the player). Empty = nothing to show yet. With `embedType` youtube/spotify the player only trusts YouTube hosts / open.spotify.com; another host is framed as generic (the type cannot be checked here, so the player enforces it).
